# Master-table coverage: what exists, what is running, what is missing

*Last updated: 2026-09-13. Generated by hand from `results/cells/`; regenerate the counts with the
inventory snippet at the end.*

The absolute master table (`tables/master_abs_<model>.tex`) wants, per model: **8 methods** — untuned,
ICL, clean LoRA, breadth, anchored, family, mixture, merge — on **23 conditions** (7 ladder, 6 depth-2
seen stacks, 4 depth-3/4 stacks, 6 unseen-containing stacks) plus the **backward ladder**. Today only
CodeLlama-7B has every arm, which is why the paper's table names that model.

## Status per method

| method | system | models complete | what is missing | how it is being closed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| untuned | `base` | 8/8 ladder + seen + unseen | depth-3/4 on 7 models | `ev_depth_*` (queued 2026-09-13) |
| ICL | `base_1shot` | ladder only, 8/8 | X1 and every stack, all models | `ev_1shot_*` (queued) |
| clean LoRA | `tuned_L0` | 8/8 except depth | depth-3/4 on 7 models | `ev_depth_*` |
| breadth | `mono_all` | 8/8 except depth | depth-3/4 on 7 models | `ev_depth_*` |
| anchored | `cons_lam3` | 8/8 except depth | depth-3/4 on 7 models | `ev_depth_*` |
| family | `tuned_X1` | 7/8 on seen stacks | seen stacks on CodeLlama-7B; depth everywhere | `ev_seenfam_codellama-7b`, `ev_depth_*` |
| merge | `merge_dare_ties` | 4/8 (7B, Llama-3.1-8B, StarCoder2, Granite) | the other four have **no specialists**; and depth + the two half-unseen stacks nowhere | `tr_{L1b,L1r,L2,S1,S2}_*` for 13B, 34B, Gemma-3, CodeGemma → `build_ready_merges.py` → a widened `merge_panel` |
| mixture | `mole_router` | 1/8 (7B) | a router gate exists only on 7B, and it mixes **eight** experts (L0–S4); the other models have five | needs S3+S4 specialists and `scripts/train_mole.py` per model — **not yet queued** |

## Backward (`inverse_generic`)

All eight models have the backward ladder for untuned, clean LoRA, breadth, anchored and family. It is
**not run for mixture or merge on any model**, so the backward block of the master table has two empty
columns everywhere. One inverse eval per arm per model closes it; the one-shot inverse template is
CodeLlama-7B-specific and most other models' backward cells are format-gated, so the value of widening
it is low until the template is adapted per model.

## Order of work

1. `ev_depth_*` (8 jobs) — fills the depth rows for five methods on every model.
2. `ev_seenfam_codellama-7b` — the one hole in the family row.
3. `ev_1shot_*` (8 jobs) — the ICL column beyond the ladder. Expect format-gated cells off 7B.
4. `tr_*` (20 trainings) — specialists for the four models without them, then merges, then a widened
   `merge_panel` covering depth and the half-unseen stacks.
5. Mixture on more models — the largest remaining piece, and the only one needing a new training
   script run (`train_mole.py`) rather than an evaluation.

## Inventory snippet

```python
import glob, collections
have = collections.defaultdict(set)
for p in glob.glob("results/cells/*/*/python/*/cell_meta.json"):
    ph, m, _, cell = p.split("/")[2:6]
    if ph.startswith("_"): continue
    s, c = cell.split("__", 1); have[(m, s, ph == "inverse_generic")].add(c)
```
